clauses.reason: The order excuses work on Friday March 4 1921 only; the proviso limits that same day. It has no operative command on March 5.

research_rationale:
The inspected one-page order excuses District federal per diem employees and day laborers from work only on Friday, March 4, 1921. Its proviso permits department heads to except offices or employees for special public reasons and excludes conflicts with existing law; it does not extend the leave to another day. The command expires after March 4, with March 5 the first day without operative force.

savings.reason: The text confers a one-day leave and contains no saving clause or independently continuing command. Pay or administrative consequences of March 4 may remain accrued but do not keep the excusal operative.
